Nothing on the page explains it; for an airport it is likely fuel sales/hangar rent (a Tri County Fuel Account is on p2), i.e. charges for services. 'other' with review is defensible as a last resort.
No airport function exists in the category list; 'other' with review is a judgment call (Stromsburg's extraction files its airport department under culture/recreation).
